rundown: Hawks beat Hornets 111-97 at State Farm Arena in Atlanta, GA in front of 15,488. Hawks came back: they were down 57-56 at the half. The 3rd quarter decided it: Hawks won it 31-19. Their win chance dropped as low as 25% along the way.
Leading the way — Hornets: Moussa Diabate 21 pts, 15 reb; Coby White 9 ast. Hawks: Jalen Johnson 26 pts; Dyson Daniels 10 ast, 8 reb.
Where Hawks won it: they shot 51% to 40%, shot 39% from three to 24% and had 28 assists to 22.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Hawks closed as 7.5-point favorites and covered by 6.5; the total closed at 219.5 and they combined for 208, under by 11.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 20, 6:56 PM ET. It had Hornets 18% and Hawks 82%, projecting Hornets 107 – Hawks 117.9 (225 total, Hawks by 10.9).

Final: Hornets 97 – Hawks 111. Right winner: it had Hawks at 82%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Hornets came in with a 5% below average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (4-10, 100.1 scored and 110.4 allowed a game over 14 games), worth about 80 and 80 games of evidence. Projected to score 107, they scored 97 (−10 points, 9% under); projected to allow 117.9, they allowed 111 (−6.9 points, 6% under).

Hawks came in with a 2% above average attack and a league-average defense (9-6, 117.7 scored and 115.8 allowed a game over 15 games), worth about 87 and 86 games of evidence. Projected to score 117.9, they scored 111 (−6.9 points, 6% under); projected to allow 107, they allowed 97 (−10 points, 9% under).

The bigger miss was Hornets' scoring (-10 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 208 against 225 projected (-17), about the 18th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Hawks by 14 against Hawks by 10.9 projected, about the 60th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Hawks ×1.02, Hornets ×1.00. It favored Hawks, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
ATL ML (-264) at -264: the algo gave it 71% vs 70% fair (+1.4 pts) — won (+0.4u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 70%). CHA ML (+217) at +217: the algo gave it 29% vs 30% fair (-1.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 30%). ATL -7.5 (-109) at -109: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1.1 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. CHA +7.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1.1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 219.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 50% vs 49% fair (+1.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 219.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 50% vs 51% fair (-1.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 22% of bets on Hornets, 23% of the money — Hawks covered; total: 34% of bets on the over, 42% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 8% of bets on Hornets, 6% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Hawks, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.921 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +3.1 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 120 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.995 and gives home teams 0 points. Team corrections so far: Hornets attack ×0.982, defense ×1.001 (7 games); Hawks attack ×1.006, defense ×1.008 (8 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
